Don't  judge  yourself  on  how  you  feel. 
 Judge  yourself  by  what  you  do  despite 
 how  you  feel. 
 So  you  can  feel  shitty.  You  can  wake  up 
 and  have  a  terrible  day  and  still  show 
 up  with  a  smile  in  front  of  the  thousand 
 people.  And  so  if  you  can  do  it  with  a 
 thousand  people,  you  can  do  it  with  one. 
 And  that  first  one  is  the  person  that 
 looks  at  you  in  the  mirror  in  the 
 morning.
